types locked to Workforce planners, the Sites and DNS section working again, and site-loss drills that report what really happened.

Away types: with only the permission to manage agents, you can change an away type's name, colour and whether agents can choose it on the desk. Everything else, such as paid, counts against staffing, can be scheduled, time off, its group and its limits, needs the Workforce planner permission, and those settings are greyed out without it. A new type made without it starts in the group Other with the usual settings.

Site-loss drills: a drill's write counter now always reports its figures when the drill ends, and a server that is still shutting down after losing the lead is shown as stepping down, not as a second primary. Drills that were marked failed for these reasons now pass when the takeover was clean.

Fixes: the Sites and DNS section of the Servers page loads again; a snag sent on from your servers no longer lists finished set-up steps as stopped services; and Hand to development is offered only where Yaxxa technical works, since on your own servers a snag is sent on with Escalate to Yaxxa technical."}
